title: MELON BALL SALAD
full_text:
2 Small Pkgs. Lemon Jello
1 Cup boiling water over jello, stir well
1 12 Oz. can frozen orange juice thawed but not diluted.
1 16 oz. pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and strained (save juice)
1 12 oz. pkg. frozen melon balls
(thawed and strained (save juice))

Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add juices that were strained from strawberries and melon balls after bringing to boil. Add orange juice, stir well and chill until it begins to set. Fold in fruit. Refrigerate until set. Serve with cool whip spread on top.
Anne Langill
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: PEAR SALAD
full_text:
1 Pkg. Lime Jello 
1 Cup Pear Juice (Hot)
Mix together and put in refrigerator until it sets a little.
1 Small Pkg. Cream Cheese 
6 Pear Halves (Mashed) Mix together with electric mixer
1 Pkg. Dream Whip
Add to pear halves and cheese mixture and fold into lime jello.
Dorothy Evenson
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: QUICK COMPANY SALAD
full_text:
1 Small Carton Cottage Cheese
1 #2 Crushed Pineapple, drained
1 10 Oz. Pkg. Miniature Marshmallows
1/2 Cup Mayonnaise
1/2 Pint Whipping Cream
Chill 3 hours. Serve on lettuce leaf.
Mary Riehl
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: PINEAPPLE-BANANA SALAD
full_text:
1 #2 Can Tidbit Pineapple
Sliced Bananas
Miniature Marshmallows
1/2 Cup Sugar
1 Egg, Beaten
2 Tbsp. Cornstarch

Drain pineapple into saucepan. In small bowl combine sugar and cornstarch. Add beaten egg to dry ingredients and mix well. Add entire mixture to pineapple juice and cook over medium heat until thick and clear. Place pineapple tidbits and desired amounts of sliced bananas and marshmallows in salad bowl and mix in dressing. The dressing is good made ahead and chilled or used immediately. This dressing will also keep for several days in a covered bowl in the refrigerator.
Linda Gilson
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: ORANGE-TAPIOCA SALAD
full_text:
1 Cup Miniature Marshmallows
1 Cup Cubed pineapple
Drain & save juice
Add enough water to make 3 C. liquid. Add to 1 pkg orange tapioca pudding mix and 1 pkg. vanilla tapioca pudding mix. Cook as directed and let cool. Add oranges, pineapple, marshmallows. Add 1 pkg. whipped dream whip. Pour into 9 x 13 glass dish and refrigerate. If you can't find orange tapioca, use regular vanilla pudding.
Agnes Frentress
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: STRAWBERRY SALAD
full_text:
2 Pkgs. Strawberry Jello
2 Cups boiling water
2 Pkgs. frozen strawberries
1 #2 can crushed pineapple
2 Large bananas, mashed
1/2 pt. carton sour cream

Dissolve Jello in water, add berries, and undrained pineapple. Mash and beat bananas and add to jello mixture. Blend well and pour one-half the mixture into a 9 x 13 pan. Let set in refrigerator until firm. Spread carton of sour cream over jello mixture. Pour remaining Jello mixture over sour cream and return to refrigerator until firm.
Serves 8
Carlita Judge
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: SUNSHINE SALAD
full_text:
Soften 1 envelope Knox gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Let stand. Heat to boiling 1 cup pineapple syrup, and stir in gelatin until dissolved.
ADD: 1/2 cup orange juice
1/4 cup mild vinegar
1/4 cup sugar
1/4 tsp. salt
Stir until sugar is dissolved and cool. When mixture begins to thicken, fold in:
1 cup grated raw carrots
1 cup orange segments
1 1/2 cups pineapple tidbits.
Turn into mold and chill. Serves 6.
Ann Pauly
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: MANDARIN ORANGE-PINEAPPLE SALAD
full_text:
2 cans Mandarin orange slices 
1 pkg. lemon gelatin
1 pkg. orange gelatin
2 cups hot water
1 pint orange sherbet
1 1/2 cups crushed pineapple

Drain oranges, reserving juice. Dissolve gelatins in hot water. Add enough water to juice from oranges to make 1 cup. Stir into gelatin mixture. Chill until thickened. Fold in sherbet and fruits.
Serves 12.
Sadie Carpenter
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: ORANGE PINEAPPLE SALAD
full_text:
1/2 can (6 oz.) frozen orange juice (undiluted)
1 egg, slightly beaten
2 tbsp. sugar
1 can (8 oz.) crushed pineapple, not drained
1 cup cream whipped (or 1 pkg. dream whip)
1/2 lb. miniature marshmallows
1 can mandarin oranges
1 can (20 oz.) pineapple tidbits, drained

Mix juice, egg, sugar and crushed pineapple in heavy saucepan. Cook, stirring until thick. Cool. Fold in remaining ingredients.
Chill 8 hours.
Rosemary Schmandt
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: FRUIT CASSEROLE
full_text:
1. Combine in 9x13 pan:
1 lb. 13 oz. can pear halves
1 lb. 13 oz. can peaches
1 lb. 13 oz. can plums
2. Spread on top of above mixture:
2 eggs
1 tsp. vanilla
1 1/2 cups sour cream
3 tbsp. brown sugar (from 1/3 cup)
1 tbsp. flour (from 3 tbsp.)
Pour over fruit and bake at 350 deg. for 15 minutes.
Add following toppings and bake 15 minutes more:
2 Tbsp. softened butter
1 Tbsp. lemon or lime juice
Remaining brown sugar & flour
1/4 tsp. nutmeg
1 pkg. crushed shortbread cookies
Mary Ann Crawford
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CHRISTMAS CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
2 cups raw cranberries - ground
3 cups miniature marshmallows
3/4 cup sugar

Cover above ingredients and chill overnight in refrigerator.

2 cups diced unpared tart apples
1/2 cup green grapes
1/2 cup broken nutmeats
1/4 tsp. salt
1 cup heavy whipped cream

Add apples, grapes, nuts, salt to first mixture. Fold in whipped cream. Chill.

Serves 8 to 10.

Maxine Smith
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: COOK & CHILL SALAD
full_text:
Whip the following together slightly:
3 egg yolks
2 tbsp. sugar
2 tbsp. vinegar
2 tbsp. pineapple syrup
1 tbsp. butter
Cook, stirring constantly until mixture coats a spoon. Cool. When cold, fold in 1 cup heavy cream, whipped. Fold this mixture into the following:
2 cups white cherries, drained
2 cups miniature marshmallows
2 cups pineapple tidbits
2 oranges, peeled and cut in small pieces.
Chill.
Rosemary Marshall
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: APPLE SALAD
full_text:
3 Medium Delicious Apples (cubed)
1 Banana — sliced
1/4 C. raisins
1/2 Cup Miniature Marshmallows
Fold in following dressing:
1/2 Cup Salad Dressing
1/2 Cup Whipped Cream
Claudine Shelledy
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: PINEAPPLE CHEESE SALAD
full_text:
1/4 cup cold water
1 tbsp. (1 envelope) unflavored gelatin
1/2 cup boiling water
2/3 cup grated cheddar cheese
1 cup crushed pineapple
1 tbsp. sugar
Pinch of salt
1/2 cup whipping cream, whipped
Soak gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes. Dissolve in boiling water. Add sugar, salt and pineapple. When mixture begins to congeal, fold in whipped cream and cheese.
Della Maitre
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: APRICOT SALAD
full_text:
Dissolve 2 pkgs. orange jello, in 2 cups boiling water. Add 1 cup pineapple juice, set aside to cool. When consistency of unbeaten egg white, stir in 1 - #2 1/2 can pineapple drained, and 1 — #2 1/2 can apricots, drained & snipped, 1/2 pkgs. miniature marshmallows. Pour into 9 x 13 pan. Chill till firm, then top with following mixture.
1/2 cup sugar, 3 tbsp. flour, 1 cup juice from canned fruit, 1 egg beaten, 2 tbsp. butter, 1 cup heavy cream, whipped, 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese. Combine sugar and flour with juice, cook over low heat stirring constantly until clear & thick. Add small amount to beaten egg. Add to pan, cook 1 minute. Stir in butter, and when completely cool, fold in whipped cream. Spread over firm fruit mixture. Sprinkle with cheese & chill.
Joan Maitre
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: NEVER-TELL SALAD
full_text:
10 Large marshmallows
1 cup Pineapple Juice
1 Pkg. Lime Jello
1 Cup Water
Combine the above and heat until marshmallows are melted. Chill until it starts to thicken.
Add: 1 Cup Cottage Cheese (cream cheese can be substituted)
1 Cup Whipped Cream
1/2 Cup pineapple chunks
1/2 Cup nut meats
Lou Koppold
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: APRICOT CREAM CHEESE SALAD
full_text:
1 - 1 qt. 14 oz. can apricot nectar
3 pkgs. lemon-flavored Jello
1 - 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese.
Heat 4 cups apricot nectar. Add 2 pkgs. lemon Jello to nectar, and stir to dissolve. Cool till partially set. Meanwhile, heat 2 additional cups apricot nectar. Add remaining pkg. jello, and stir to dissolve. Whip in cream cheese, which should be at room temperature. Chill until partially set.
Place half plain mixture in a 2 qt. mold. Add the cheese layer, then the rest of the plain apricot jello. Chill until firm. 10 servings.
Mary Johnson
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CHERRY CHEESE SALAD
full_text:
Dissolve 1 pkg. Black Cherry Gelatin in 1 cup hot water. Add juice from Bing cherries and enough cold water to make a cup. Chill until slightly thickened.
1 - 3 oz. pkg. cream cheese, formed into small balls
1/4 cup chopped pecans
1 cup chopped Bing cherries
1/4 cup stuffed olives
Add all this to thickened gelatin and chill until set.
Serves 8.
Joanne Sassatelli
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: RED, RED SALAD
full_text:
1 Large or 2 Small Pkgs. of Raspberry Jello
2 Cups hot water
1 Can Whole Cranberry Sauce
1 10 oz. Pkg. frozen raspberries
2 Tbsp. lemon juice
Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add other ingredients. Raspberries need not be defrosted. Stir until they are separated.
Fill five cup mold and chill.
Opal Grandfield
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CRANBERRY MOLDED SALAD
full_text:
1/2 pkg. cranberries
1 cup sugar
1 cup water
Boil for 6 minutes and cool.
2 pkg. cherry Jello
1 cup boiling water
Let set a little.
Combine above ingredients. Add a 12 oz. pkg. sour cream and 1 cup chopped nuts. Put in a mold and chill.
Barbara Redpath
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CHIFFON FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
1 1/2 cups well drained peach slices
1 cup hot peach syrup (or peach syrup & water)
1 3 Oz. Pkg. lemon gelatin
1/2 cup diced celery
1/2 cup chopped nuts
1/3 cup mayonnaise
2 1/2 cups whipped Carnation Instant
Line bottom of mold with peach slices for garnish. Chop remaining slices. Mix hot peach syrup and gelatin to dissolve gelatin. Chill until thickened.
Add celery, nuts & mayonnaise. Add chopped peaches. Blend. Mix with whipped Carnation Instant. Spoon into mold. Chill until firm (about 3 hours). Unmold on lettuce.
To Whip Carnation Instant:
1. Mix 1/2 cup Carnation Instant Magic Crystals with 1/2 cup ice water.
2. Whip until soft peaks form (3-4 Min) Add 2 Tbsp. lemon juice.
3. Continue beating until stiff peaks form. (3-4 Minutes longer.)
Elsie Kruse
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: FROSTED FRUIT
full_text:
2 cups drained pineapple tidbits
2 cups red grapes (halved & seeded)
2 cups miniature marshmallows
Combine above ingredients.
1/2 cup syrup from pineapple
1/4 cup water
2 tbsp. corn starch
Cook over low heat until thick and clear. Add 1 beaten egg and a dash of salt. Heat and cool. Pour over fruit. Toss lightly and chill overnight. Fold in 1 cup whipped cream (or 1 pkg. dream whip) and 3 sliced bananas. Chill.
Serves 10 to 12.
Carol Nichols
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: MINTED FRUIT FREEZE
full_text:
2/3 cup Kraft mint-flavored apple jelly
1 cup mayonnaise
1 cup miniature marshmallows
1 cup diced pears
1 and 1/3 cups (13 1/2 oz. can) pineapple tidbits (drained)
1 cup heavy cream (whipped)
Melt jelly over low heat; gradually add to mayonnaise, mixing well. Add marshmallows and fruit. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into 1 1/2 qt. mold and freeze.
Serves 6 to 8.
Bev Watson
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CINNAMON JELLO SALAD
full_text:
Dissolve 2 pkgs. cherry jello in 2 cups of boiling water.
Dissolve 1/2 cup of red hots in 1 cup of hot water. Add enough cold water to equal 2 cups liquid, and add to jello mixture.
Cool until soft set, and add to above:
2 cups chopped apples, unpeeled
2 cups chopped celery
1 cup chopped nuts
Chill until firm.
Phyllis Cardwell
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
1 3-oz pkg. cream cheese
1 small can crushed pineapple (not drained)
15 large marshmallows - cut up - or 1 1/2 cups small marshmallows
1/2 cup chopped nuts
15 maraschino cherries (diced)
1/2 pint whipping cream or 1 pkg. dream whip
Add pineapple and marshmallows to cream cheese. Fold in whipped cream, cherries and nuts. Put in container and freeze.
Rosie Bell
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: FROSTY MARSHMALLOW SALAD
full_text:
1 Pkg. Cherry Jello
1 Sm. Can Drained Crushed Pineapple
1 Can Bing Cherries, drained
20 Marshmallows
1/2 Cup Milk
1 Cup Whipped Cream
Measure cherry juice-add water to make 2 cups. Heat and combine with Jello. Pour into a flat dish until partially set. Add Cherries.
Topping: Heat marshmallows and milk. Stir until dissolved and cool. Fold in whipped cream and pineapple. Spread over jello and sprinkle with nuts.
Joy Weir
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: FROZEN STRAWBERRY SALAD
full_text:
3 Tbsp. strawberry juice
20 large marshmallows
1 Small can crushed pineapple, drained.
1 Quart strawberries, drained
1 Pt. cottage cheese
1 Cup cream, whipped
Heat 3 Tbsp. strawberry juice, add marshmallows. Stir until marshmallows are melted. Cool and add pineapple, strawberries, cottage cheese, and fold in whipped cream. Put in fluted cup cake liners, and freeze.
Connie Edwards
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: MAMA'S BLUEBERRY SALAD
full_text:
2 Pkgs. Raspberry Jello
1 Pkg. Cherry or Strawberry Jello
1 #2 can crushed pineapple
1 #2 can blueberries
1 Pkg. Dream Whip
Mix the two pkgs. of Raspberry Jello with 2 cups of hot water and juice drained from blueberries and pineapple. Stir until well blended, then add both blueberries and pineapple. Put in refrigerator to chill.
Make Cherry Or Strawberry Jello as directed and put in refrigerator until consistency of egg white. Whip cream and add to half set Jello
 Beat until well mixed and pour on top of other Jello and fruit mixture. (Be sure fruit mixture is firm before adding second mixture).
Shirley Harris
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: RASPBERRY-APPLESAUCE SALAD
full_text:
2 3-oz Pkgs. Raspberry Gelatin
2 Pkgs. Frozen Raspberries-thawed
1 Can (2 cups) Applesauce
Topping: 1 Cup Commercial Sour Cream
1 (10 1/2 Oz.) Pkg. Miniature marshmallows
Whipping Cream - If desired
Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups boiling water. Mix berries with applesauce, add to dissolved gelatin. Pour into a 9 x 13 dish. Chill until set.
Topping: In a bowl, mix sour cream and as many marshmallows as the cream will hold. Let stand overnight in refrigerator, then whip and spread in a thin layer over salad. For a fluffier topping, fold 1 cup whipped cream into the marshmallow mixture.
Serves 12
Phyllis Goulden
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: STRAWBERRY WINE MOLD
full_text:
3 pkgs. strawberry gelatin
1 1/2 cups boiling water
1 1/2 cups Rose wine
1 quart fresh strawberries
1/2 cup sugar
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; stir in wine. Set aside 12 nice berries for top of mold. Slice remaining berries and mix with sugar. Halve the 12 prettiest berries and arrange cut-side down in a 6 1/2 cup ring molds: cover with a thin layer of gelatin and chill until firm. Add remaining berries to the rest of the gelatin (slightly thickened) and pour over the first layer. Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce or watercress.
Rose Ann Parr
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: DOUBLE LEMON SALAD
full_text:
2 pkgs. lemon gelatin
2 cups boiling water
1/2 cup cold water
1 can lemon pie filling
1 can (1 lb. 4 oz.) crushed pineapple with juice
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and stir in remaining ingredients. Chill in ring mold.
Deanna Cook
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: SHRIMP AND GRAPEFRUIT MOLD
full_text:
1 pkg. (6 oz.) lime gelatin
1 teas. salt
2 cups boiling water
1 1/4 cups cold water
2 tbsp. vinegar
2 tbsp. finely chopped onion
1 cup diced cooked shrimp
1/2 cup diced grapefruit sections
2 tbsp. chopped green pepper
1/4 cup mayonnaise
1 cup chopped celery
Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water. Add cold water, vinegar and onion. Measure 1 1/2 cups, and chill till thickened slightly, add shrimp, grapefruit and green pepper. Pour into 6 cup mold. Blend mayonnaise into remaining gelatin. Add celery and spoon over set gelatin mixture. Chill till firm. Serves 6.
Fabienne Guiney.
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CUCUMBER SALAD MOLD
full_text:
2 Med. cucumbers, grated with skins on to make 2 cupfuls. Add little water to make up difference, if necessary.
2 Tbsp. grated onion
1 Tsp. salt, 2 Tsp. plain gelatin combined with 2 Tbsp. cold water
2 Pkgs. lemon gelatin, dissolved in
2 cups boiling water, and a little green coloring
Add the plain gelatin to the very hot water.
1/4 cup grated horseradish and about
3 to 4 tablespoons vinegar.
Combine all ingredients in order given. Pour into a medium size well oiled mold, or a plain bowl. Let stand in refrigerator for 8 hours or longer or until very firm to the touch.
This mold is delicious with any cold or hot meat dish or seafood, and is especially attractive for buffets.
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: LUNCHEON SALAD
full_text:
2 cups medium width noodles
1 small box frozen shrimp
1/2 cup diced celery
1/2 cup fresh lettuce (cut in small pieces)
1 tbsp. Lawry's seasoned salt Mayonnaise - 2 teas. minced onion
Cook noodles until tender. Cook shrimp as directed on package.
Cut in small pieces. Add to noodles, with remaining ingredients, and desired amount of mayonnaise. Chill in refrigerator. Serve as main course, with garlic bread.
Hilda Huston
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: TUNA SALAD MOLD
full_text:
1 - 3 oz. Lemon jello
1/4 teas. salt
1 cup boiling water
3/4 cup cold water
1 tbsp. lemon juice
1/2 cup mayonnaise
1 teas. grated onion
1/2 cup chopped cucumber
1 - 7 oz. can tuna, drained & flaked
1/4 cup sliced stuffed olives
2 tbsp. chopped pimiento.
Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Add cold water, lemon juice, mayonnaise, and onion. Chill till very thick. Fold in remaining ingredients. Pour into 1 qt. mold. Serve on salad greens. Makes 4 cups.
Carolyn Ostergaard
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: SASSY SHRIMP MOLD
full_text:
1 env. Knox gelatin
1/2 cup cold water
1 - 8 oz bottle Kraft Thousand Island Dressing
1 - 8 oz pkg. cream cheese.
1 tbsp. lemon juice
1/2 teas. salt
2 cups chopped cooked shrimp
1/2 cup chopped celery
This is quick and easy to make, if you have cream cheese at room temperature when blending. Soften gelatin in water, stir over low heat until dissolved. Gradually add thousand island dressing to cream cheese; mix until well blended. Stir in lemon juice, salt and gelatin; fold in shrimp and celery. Pour into 1 qt. mold, chill until firm. Unmold. Serves 4 - 6.
Martha Holzworth
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CHICKEN SALAD
full_text:
2 3-oz. pkgs. cream cheese, softened
1 cup sour cream
1/4 cup mayonnaise
Dash of salt
1 cup sliced celery
1/2 cup slivered almonds
4 tbsp. chopped green pepper
3 cups cubed cooked chicken
1 cup green grapes
In mixer bowl, beat together cream cheese, sour cream and salt. Stir in celery, almonds and green pepper. Fold in chicken and grapes. Chill mixture thoroughly.
Serves 8 to 10.
Harriett Morey
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: THANKSGIVING COLE SLAW
full_text:
Shred 1 large head cabbage fine.
Beat 4 eggs until light and frothy. Add 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup cold water, 1/2 cup cider vinegar, 1/2 teas. salt, and dash pepper. Mix well, and cook in double boiler until thick. Remove from fire, and pour HOT dressing over cabbage. When cooled, put in refrigerator, until thoroughly chilled. Better if made 24 hours ahead.
Kay Frank
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CABBAGE SALAD
full_text:
4 cups sugar
2 cups vinegar
1 cup water.
Mix together, boil 2 minutes & cool.
Shred two heads of cabbage, add 2 tbsp. salt. Let stand 1 hour, squeeze out juice. Add to cabbage 1 bunch celery chopped, 2 green peppers, chopped, 2 red peppers, chopped, 1 teas. celery seed, 1 teas. mustard seed. Add cooled syrup to cabbage mixture and refrigerate. After 24 hours this is very crisp, and will keep well in the refrigerator for several weeks.
Lorna Pieres
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: BLUE CHEESE SALAD DRESSING
full_text:
1 pt. Miracle Whip, 1 cup sour cream, 8 oz. bleu cheese, 2 tbsp. anchovy paste, 4 tbsp. lemon juice and 2 garlic buds, minced.
Wanda Baedero
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: SALAD DRESSING
full_text:
Grate one large onion, cover with one cup of sugar. Let stand 30 minutes. Add 1 teas. salt, 1/2 cup vinegar, 1/2 teas. celery seed, 2 cups salad oil.
Wanda Baedero
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: FRENCH DRESSING
full_text:
1/3 cup catsup, 1/3 cup sugar, 1/4 cup vinegar, 1/2 cup salad oil, 1 teas. salt, 1 teas. onion, and 1 teas. paprika. Place all ingredients in a jar and shake well before serving. For a thicker, homogenized dressing place all ingredients in a blender.
Wanda Baedero
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: BEAN & VEGETABLE SALAD
full_text:
1 Can Green Beans
1 Can Yellow Beans
1 Can Kidney Beans
Drain well and add:
1 Large onion, cut in rings
1 Small Green pepper, diced
2 Stalks celery, chopped
Over this pour the following mixture:
1 Tsp. salt
Dash of pepper
1/3 cup salad oil
3/4 cup sugar
2/3 cup apple cider vinegar
Allow beans and vegetables to marinate 24 hours.
Cathy Mataya
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: SPICED BEET SALAD
full_text:
1 Pkg. Lemon Jello dissolved in
1 Cup boiling water.
1 Cup beet juice & pineapple combined.
1 1/2 cups diced pickled beets
1 Cup crushed pineapple
1 Cup salted pecans, chopped
When gelatin is cool, add rest of ingredients.
Serves 6 to 8
Helen McDowell
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: WILTED LEAF LETTUCE SALAD
full_text:
2 Large Bundles Leaf Lettuce
2 Tsp. Sugar
2 Green onions - sliced
4 Slices Bacon
1/4 Cup Salad Vinegar
2 Tbsp. Water
2 Hard cooked eggs (quartered)
Tear lettuce in bowl. Season with salt, pepper. Add onion, sugar. Fry bacon crisp - crumble. Add vinegar and water to drippings, heat to boiling point. Pour over lettuce - toss till wilted.
Add bacon & eggs. Very good.
Katherine Pizinger
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: KRAUT SALAD
full_text:
1 #303 Can Sauerkraut - drain well. Squeeze with hands
1 Onion - chopped
1 Green Pepper - chopped
1 Sm. Can Pimento - chopped
1 Cup Celery - chopped
1/3 Cup salad oil
1/2 cup Sweet Relish
1 Tbsp. Vinegar
1 Cup White sugar
Mix well, cover & chill for 24 hours. Makes 6 cups. Keeps for a week.
Ardeane Snook
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CREAMY COLESLAW
full_text:
1 cup sour cream
1/2 teas. celery seed
1/2 teas. salt
3 tbsp. sugar
1/4 cup white vinegar
1/2 cup salad oil
1 med. head cabbage, shredded fine.
Mix sour cream, celery seed, salt and sugar. Gradually blend in vinegar and oil. Add cabbage. Mix thoroughly and chill.
Marguerite Wines
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: PHILADELPHIA STEW
full_text:
5 cups shredded cabbage
1/4 cup finely chopped carrots
1/4 cup finely chopped green pepper
Combine 1 t. salt, 1/4 teas. pepper, 1 teas. grated onion, 2 tbsp. sugar, 1/2 teas. dry mustard, 1/3 cup cider vinegar, and 2 tbsp. salad oil.
Pour over cabbage.
Henriette Lastuvka
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: SEASONED CABBAGE SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. lime jello
3 tbsp. vinegar
1 cup boiling water
1 cup cold water
Dissolve jello, add cold water and vinegar and let set until slightly thickened. Then add following:
1/2 cup cabbage, shredded
1/4 cup carrots, chopped
1/4 cup celery, chopped
1/4 cup green olives, sliced
1 tbsp. onion, chopped
Dash of salt - 1 Tsp. Sugar
Dash of Beau Monde Herbs. Chill.
Carrie Haigh
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CAESAR SALAD
full_text:
1 clove garlic
1/2 cup salad oil
3/4 head lettuce
1 cup croutons
2 or 3 tomatoes
1 beaten egg
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/4 cup lemon juice
1 tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2 tsp. pepper
1/2 tsp. salt
Mash garlic and add to salad oil, let stand. Break lettuce in bowl. Add croutons and tomatoes. Strain salad oil to remove garlic. Pour over vegetables. Combine remaining ingredients; beat well. Pour over salad and toss lightly. Garnish with sliced tomatoes.
Wanda Baedaro
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: CAESAR SALAD, GOURMET
full_text:
Start with large wooden salad bowl that is unfinished on the inside. Rub salad bowl surface with a cut garlic clove. Mash 1/2 of garlic clove with fork in bowl. Add 3 anchovy fillets (if you like.) 1 tbsp. salad oil, 1/2 teas. dry mustard, grind pepper over all. Cream mixture in bowl. Blend in 4 teas. lemon juice, 1 1/2 tbsp. salad vinegar, 1/2 teas. worcestershire sauce, and 2 more tbsp. salad oil. Blend and set aside. Place 1 egg in boiling water, and let stand 1 minute. Break into salad bowl. Blend till dressing looks creamy. Gently toss 8 cups of broken lettuce and romaine with dressing. Add 2 tbsp. parmesan cheese, and 1 packet Devonshire Plain Melba toast, broken. Toss & Serve. 6-8 servings.
Martha Holzworth
organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

title: RIBBON SALAD
full_text:
2 - 3 oz. pkg. lime jello
1 - 8 oz. cream cheese
5 cups hot water
1 - (1 lb. 4 oz.) crushed pineapple
4 cups cold water
1 cup heavy cream whipped
1/2 cup miniature marshmallows
1 cup mayonnaise
1 - 3 oz. lemon jello
2 - 3 oz. pkgs. cherry jello
1 cup pineapple juice
Dissolve lime jello in 2 cups hot water. Add 2 cups cold water. Pour into 14 x 10 x 2 pan. Chill until partially set. Dissolve lemon jello in 1 cup hot water in top of double boiler. Add marshmallows and stir to melt. Remove from heat. Add 1 cup drained pineapple juice and cream cheese. Beat until well blended and stir in pineapple. Cool slightly. Fold in whipped cream and mayonnaise. Chill. Pour in layer over lime jello. Chill until almost set. Dissolve cherry jello in 2 cups hot and 2 cups cold water. Chill until syrupy. Pour over pineapple layer. Chill until firm.
Serves 24.
Mrs. Jack Heinje
Mrs. Ed. Myers
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: APRICOT SALAD
full_text:
2 pkgs. orange jello
2 cups boiling water
1 No. 2 1/2 can apricots (mashed and drained)
1 No. 2 can pineapple (drained)
1 cup mixed pineapple and apricot juice
1 cup miniature marshmallows
Mix all the above and put in 9 x 13 dish. When firm, top with the following:
1 cup mixed pineapple and apricot juice
3 tbls. flour
1 beaten egg
1/2 cup sugar
2 tbls. butter
Cook this until thick. When cool, add 1 cup cream whipped. Spread over jello and top with grated cheese.
Mrs. V. L. O'Mara
Mrs. W. E. Cudworth
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: QUEEN'S SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. lime jello
2 cups boiling water
Mix and chill until slightly jelled. Then add:
1 can drained pineapple
2 large bananas
2 - 3 tsp. lemon juice
1 cup miniature marshmallows
When above is firm, put the following custard on top:
Use drained pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add 1/2 cup sugar and 2 tbls. flour mixed together. Add 1 beaten egg and 2 tbls. butter. Boil until thick, then cool. Fold in 1 cup cream whipped (1 pkg. dream whip). Spread over mixture and top with grated cheese. Serve on lettuce with a few fancy crackers.
Mrs. V. L. O'Mara
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: MOUNTAIN DEW SALAD
full_text:
2 pkg. lemon jello
1 tall can crushed pineapple
2 cups boiling water
2 bananas sliced
2 cups juice from pineapple
1 cup miniature marshmallows
1 sm. bottle Mountain Dew soda
Refrigerate until set, then top with topping.
1 envelope Dream Whip (stiff)
Fold in pkg. of lemon pudding and pie mix dry
Refrigerate until set.
Orra Mullenix
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: HALLOWEEN SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. orange jello
Mix jello according to pkg. and add black prunes.
Hans Nickel
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CHERRY SALAD SUPREME
full_text:
1 - 3 oz. pkg. raspberry jello
1 - 21 oz. can cherry pie filling
1 - 3 oz. pkg. lemon jello
1 - 3 oz. pkg. cream cheese
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 - 8 3/4 oz. can crushed pineapple
1/2 cup whipping cream
1 cup miniature marshmallows
2 tbls. chopped nuts
Dissolve raspberry jello in 1 cup boiling water. Stir in pie filling. Turn into a 9 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Chill until set. Dissolve lemon jello in 1 cup boiling water. Beat together cream cheese and mayonnaise. Slowly add lemon jello. Stir in undrained pineapple. Whip cream, fold into lemon mixture together with the marshmallows. Spread atop cherry layer and sprinkle with nuts. Chill until set. You can use any flavor jello and pie filling.
Mrs. Eula Voehl
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: 7 UP JELLO SALAD
full_text:
Dissolve 1 pkg. lime jello in 3/4 cup hot water. Add 1 bottle 7 Up soda. When it starts to set, add 3 bananas (cut very fine) and 1/2 cup walnuts (cut very fine). Refrigerate and chill until firm.
Mrs. Ida Pfeffer
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: SALAD
full_text:
2 pkgs. lemon Jello
1 can lemon pie filling
2 cups hot water
1 - 16 oz can crushed pineapple undrained
1/2 cup cold water
Dissolve jello in hot water and add rest of ingredients. Chill until set and frost with:
1 pkg. (large) cream cheese
2 tbls. cream
2 tbls. salad dressing
dash of salt
Minda Etheridge
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: GREEN AND WHITE SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. lime jello
1 pkg. Knox gelatin
1/2 tsp salt
1 sm. pkg. cream cheese
1 1/2 cup cottage cheese
1/4 cup cult. sour cream or 1/2 cup cream whipped
2 cups boiling water
1 cup crushed pineapple drained
1/2 cup pineapple juice with 1/2 cup water
Dissolve Knox gelatine in 1/2 cup cold water, add salt and 1 cup boiling water. Stir until thoroughly dissolved. Cool. Blend cream cheese and sour cream or whipped cream. Add with cottage cheese to Knox mixture and pour into mold. Chill until set. Dissolve lime jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add pineapple juice, cold water and drained pineapple. Pour over firm cottage cheese mixture in mold. Refrigerate at least 3 hr. Top with dressing if you wish.
Thelma Jacobsen
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: SHERBERT SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. orange jello
1 cup hot water
1 pt. orange sherbert
1 can mandarin oranges (drained)
1 or 2 bananas sliced
chopped nuts (optional)
Mix gelatin, hot water and orange sherbert. When slightly thickened, add orange slices, bananas and nuts. Chill.
Mildred Harmon
Thelma Jacobsen
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: IDA'S SALAD
full_text:
2 pkgs. lime jello
1 tbls. vinegar
2 tbls. sugar
2 apples peeled and diced
2 stalks celery diced
1 sm. can crushed pineapple
1/2 cup stuffed olives, cut up
Mrs. Ida Pfeffer
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: ORANGE SHERBERT SALAD
full_text:
Crust:
1/2 cup butter
2 tbls. sugar
1 cup flour
dash of salt
Press into a 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 325 for 20 to 25. min.
Filling:
2 cans (11 oz.) mandarin oranges
3 cups hot water
2 pkg. orange gelatin
1 pt. orange sherbert
Drain mandarin oranges reserving liquid. Dissolve gelatin in the hot water. Add water to the orange liquid to make 1 cup and add to jello. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat until frothy. Add sherbert and beat until well blended. Fold in orange sections. Pour in baked crust and chill.
Mrs. Roger Elsen
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: DELICIOUS SALAD
full_text:
1 - 3 oz. lemon jello
1/4 cup candy red hots
1 cup hot water
1 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce
1 sm. pkg. cream cheese
2 tbls. thick cream
1 tbls. mayonnaise
Dissolve red hots in hot water. While water is still hot, dissolve gelatine. Let cool and add applesauce. Pour half of mixture into a mold and let set. Whip together the cream cheese, cream and mayonnaise. Spread over the set mixture in the mold. Cool. Then add remaining jello.
Mrs. Ed. Myers
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CHERRY SNOW SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. cherry jello
Fruit to taste
2 cups water
1 cup Cool Whip
Make jello according to package. Cool until almost set. Add Cool Whip and beat with rotary beater. Add fruit and chill.
Mrs. Mel Roewert
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: JELLO SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. red rasberry jello - dissolved in 1 cup hot water
1 pkg. frozen red raspberries, drained
1 cup apple sauce
Chill jello (do not let it start to set) and then add the raspberries and apple sauce.
DRESSING
1 carton sour cream
1 cup small marshmallows
Whip together thoroughly and let stand for a long time.
Sophie Kunzman
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: HORSERADISH MOLD
full_text:
1 pkg. lemon jello
1 1/2 cup hot water
Stir jello into hot water and when nearly set, add 4 tbls. horseradish, 1/4 teas. salt, 1/2 teas. paprika, 1/4 cup stuffed olives (sliced), 1/2 cup cream whipped. Pour in mold. Very good with ham.
Erna Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: RASPBERRY DELIGHT SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. raspberry jello
1 cup hot water
1 cup vanilla ice cream
3 tbls orange juice
1 - 9 oz. can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1/2 cup chopped pecans
1 medium sliced banana
Combine jello and hot water. Add ice cream and then orange juice. Let partly thicken. Add fruit and nuts. Chill until firm.
Orra Mullenix
Erna Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: JELLO APPLE SALAD
full_text:
2 medium red apples (unpeeled and diced)
1/4 cup diced celery
1 - 3 oz. jello (lemon or pineapple)
Prepare jello as directed on box. Cool to syrupy stage. Stir in apples and celery. Pour into 8' square pan. Sprinkle with nut meats. Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce with dressing if you wish.
Marjorie Martsching
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: SUNSHINE SALAD
full_text:
Gelatine base:
1 pkg. lemon jello
1 pkg. orange jello
2 cups boiling water
10 cut up marshmallows or 40 miniature ones
1 1/2 cups cold water
1 #2 can crushed pineapple (drained)
2 bananas diced
Topping:
1 egg beaten
2 tbls. flour
2 tbls. butter
1/2 cup sugar
1 cup pineapple juice
1 cup cream whipped
1/2 cup shredded cheese
For base dissolve both packages of gelatin in hot water, add cold water and cool until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Add fruit and marshmallows. Pour into 9 x 13 pan. Chill.
For topping combine first 5 ingredients into sauce pan and cook until thick. Cool. Fold in whipped cream and spread over chilled gelatine. Sprinkle with cheese. Pour in mold. Chill. Easy to double.
Mrs. Jack Heinje
Mrs. V. L. O'Mara
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
full_text:
2 pkgs. strawberry jello
2 cups boiling water
1 cup sour cream
1 cup bananas (well mashed)
1 cup crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 pkg. frozen strawberries
Dissolve jello and add bananas, pineapple and strawberries, divide into 2 parts. Place 1 part in 9 x 9 dish and chill until very firm. Spread with sour cream and add the other half of jello mixture. Chill at least 6 hours.
Evelyn Yahn
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: ZESTY LIME MOLD
full_text:
1 pkg. lime jello
1 1/2 cups ginger ale
1 cup canned white grapes (drained)
1 cup crushed pineapple (drained)
Heat ginger ale to boiling and dissolve lime jello in it. Cool until syrupy. Add fruits. Turn in a 4 cup mold. Chill. Serves 6.
Eula Voehl
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CLUB SALAD
full_text:
Mix 1 pkg. lime jello. Pour into 9 x 12 x 2 pan or in mold and let set until hard.
Dissolve 1 pkg. lemon jello. While jello is still hot, mix in 15 marshmallows so they will dissolve. Cool. Then add 1 cup whipped cream, 1 small can crushed pineapple (drain), 1/2 cup sugar and 1 pkg. cream cheese. Pour this over first jello and let set until hard. Lastly mix 1 pkg. cherry jello, cool and pour on top of other layers. Let it harden.
This is very colorful at Christmas
Mrs. John Schmidt
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: PARTY SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. cherry jello
1 cup boiling water
1 can (29 oz.) bing cherries (drained)
1/2 cup liquid from cherries
1 medium banana
1 tbls. lemon juice
1 cup drained mandarin oranges
Dissolve jello in water, add cherry and lemon juice. Chill slightly. Fold in fruit. Pour into mold. Chill.
Mrs. V. L. O'Mara
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: ORANGE SHERBET SALAD
full_text:
2 pkg. orange gelatine
2 cups boiling water
1 pt. (2 cups) orange sherbert
1 can mandarin oranges (drain)
1 small can crushed pineapple (drain)
2 bananas (optional)
Dissolve gelatine in boiling water. Add sherbert. Stir well, then add fruit. Chill. Serves 12 - 15.
Mrs. Henry W. Thomas
Orra Mullenix
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: VELVET CREAM SALAD
full_text:
2 pkgs. lime jello
3 cups water
1 cup heavy cream
1 cup salad dressing
8 maraschino cherries
2 cups miniature marshmallows
2 cups drained crushed pineapple
Dissolve jello in boiling water. Whip cream and add salad dressing to it in same bowl and beat until completely blended.
Next stir in gelatine and add marshmallows, pineapple and chopped cherries. Turn into mold and chill.
Mrs. V. L. O'Mara
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: LIME SALAD
full_text:
2 pkgs. lime jello
2 cups hot water
1 cup crushed pineapple (drained)
1 - 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese or 1 cup cottage cheese
1 cup whipping cream
pinch of salt
Whip jello then fold in pineapple, cheese and whipped cream. Add salt.
Mrs. Jack Heinje
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: GOLDEN FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
2 - 3 oz. pkgs orange jello
2 cups boiling water
1 1/2 cups cold water
1 - 11 oz. can mandarin oranges
1 - 8 3/4 oz. can apricot halves
1 cup white seedless grapes
2 large bananas sliced
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water, add cold water. Chill until syrupy. Drain fruit reserving 1 cup liquid. Fold fruit into chilled jello and pour into 12 x 7 x 2 pan. Chill over night and frost with Fluffy Topping. Top with 1/4 cup grated cheese
Fluffy Topping:
6 tbls. sugar
2 tbls. corn starch
1 slightly beaten egg
1 cup reserved fruit liquid
2 tbls butter
1 tbls. lemon juice
1 cup heavy cream or 2 oz. pkg. dessert topping mix whipped
Combine sugar and corn starch in heavy saucepan. Blend in egg and liquid. Cook, stirring constantly, over low heat until thickened. Remove from heat, stir in butter and lemon juice. Cool. Fold in whipped cream or topping mix.
Mrs. Jack Heinje
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: PINEAPPLE - BANANA SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. lemon jello
1 small can crushed pineapple (save the juice)
2 bananas
8 large marshmallows cut up
Dissolve jello, mix in rest of ingredients and let set.
Topping: Cook 1 egg, 2 tbls flour, 1/2 cup sugar and liquid from pineapple and enough water to make 1 cup. Let cool. Whip 1 cup cream and mix with cooked mixture. Put on jello. Sprinkle with greated cheese.
Mrs. Sophie Kunzman
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CUCUMBER - PINEAPPLE SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. lime jello
1 pkg. lemon jello
1 cucumber finely grated
1 cup whipped cream
1 small can crushed pineapple
1/4 cup salad dressing
Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 cups boiling water and add 1 1/2 cups cold water including pineapple juice drained from pineapple. Chill until syrupy and whip slightly. Add pineapple and drained cucumber to jello. Whip cream, add salad dressing and add to jello mixture. Chill. You may add almonds or miniature marshmallows if you like.
Mrs. Erna Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: PEACH SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. lemon jello
1 cup hot water
1 cup gingerale or 7 up
2 cups drained canned peaches
1/2 cup celery (cut up)
1/4 cup nut meats
Dissolve jello in water. Add soda and rest of ingredients. Chill.
Mrs. Orra Mullinex
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: BREATH OF SPRING SALAD
full_text:
1 #2 can Sliced pineapple
1 pkg. lemon jello
Maraschino cherries
1 pkg. lime jello
1 cup boiling water
1 1/2 cups creamed cottage cheese
Drain pineapple, reserve syrup and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups. Heat to boiling. Dissolve lemon jello in it. Arrange pineapple slices in pyrex dish. Put a maraschino cherry in each center. Pour lemon jello over. Chill until set. Dissolve lime jello in boiling water. Add cottage cheese and mix well. Cool until syrupy. Pour over pineapple lemon layer. Chill until firm. Cut with pineapple slice in each serving. Serves 8.
Mrs. Eula Voehl
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: BEET AND CABBAGE SALAD
full_text:
Equal portions of beets and red cabbage. Both cooked and chopped. White cabbage may be used. Add horseradish (1 bottle) or to taste. Heat to boiling cider vinegar, sugar and salt. Mix with rest of ingredients and heat thoroughly. About 2 or 3 min.
Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CABBAGE SALAD
full_text:
Medium head of cabbage
1 red pepper
1 green pepper
3 or 4 stalks celery
1 med. onion
1 small carrot (optional)
Dressing mixture for above:
3/4 cup cooking oil
1/4 cup cold water
3/4 cup vinegar
1 1/2 cups sugar
1 pkg. Knox gelatin
Mix and bring to boil (do not boil). Pour over vegatables. Will keep for some time.
Mrs. Sophie Kunzman
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CABBAGE SALAD
full_text:
Large head of cabbage
2 tbls. salt
Let stand 1 hour. Drain well.
Boil 5 minutes and let cool:
2 cups vinegar
3 cups sugar
1 cup water
Add:
1/2 cup diced green peppers
2 cups celery diced
1/2 cup diced onions (optional)
A little celery seed
Put in jar or container.
Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: POINSETTA SALAD
full_text:
Lettuce bed with tomato wedges arranged like a poinsetta. Sprinkle chopped hard boiled eggs in center. Garnish with green pepper stems.
Mr. Hans Nickel
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: PERFECTION SALAD
full_text:
2 envelopes unflavored gelatin
2 tsp. lemon juice
1/2 cup sugar
1 1/2 cup finely shredded cabbage
1 tsp salt
1 cup celery
2 1/2 cup boiling water
1/4 cup pimento
1/2 cup vinegar
1/2 cup chopped green pepper
Thoroughly mix gelatin, sugar and salt, stirring until sugar dissolves. Add lemon juice and vinegar, cool. When mixture begins to thicken add remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 5 x 2 pan. Garnish with ripe olives.
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: KRAUT SALAD
full_text:
2 - 303 cans kraut drained
1 jar pimentos (chopped)
1 cup chopped onion
1 cup chopped celery
1 cup sugar
Mix the above together and let stand over night.
Mrs. Jack Heinje
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: NEW CABBAGE SLAW
full_text:
2 cups shredded new cabbage
1/2 cup diced cucumbers
1/2 cup diced celery
1/4 cup chopped green pepper
1 tsp. salt
1/4 tsp. paprika
Combine above ingredients and chill, then combine:
1/2 cup salad dressing
2 tbls. vinegar
1 tsp. prepared mustard
Pour over vegetables and toss lightly. Serve in leafy cabbage bowl and trim with cucumber cuts.
Mrs. Evelyn Yahn
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: ANTIPASTO FOR BUFFET SALAD
full_text:
1 cup green or red pepper strips
1 cup sliced small dill pickles
1 cup sliced small sweet pickles
1 cup turnips cut in strips
1 No. 2 can okra
1 cup pimentoes
1 cup sliced carrots
1 cup celery strips
1 cup onion strips
Sauce for Antipasto:
3/4 cup cider vinegar
1 cup corn oil
1 cup water
2 small cans tomato paste
1 tsp. tabasco sauce
2 tbls. sugar
1 tbls. worchester sauce
salt to taste
Bring to a boil, add vegetables and cook for 10 minutes. Let cool and serve. Will keep 3 - 4 weeks in refrigerator.
Hans R. Nickel
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: BACON AND MACARONI SALAD
full_text:
1/2 lb. bacon cut in 1 in. pieces
1 cup diced celery
1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni
3/4 cup mayonnaise
1/2 cup sweet pickle relish
1/2 cup chopped onion
2 tbls. pimento strips
Cook macaroni as directed on package. Fry bacon until crisp and drain on paper towel. Add bacon and remaining ingredients to drained macaroni. Mix lightly to combine evenly. Chill.
Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: COOL AS A CUCUMBER SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. lime jellon
1 tbls. vinegar
1 large cucumber (unpeeled and grated)
1 cup hot water
1/2 cup mayonnaise
1 tbls. grated onion
Dissolve jello in hot water and cool until slightly thickened. Beat together vinegar and mayonnaise. Add to gelatin with cucumber and onion. Serves 6.
Mrs Erna Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: APPLE PINEAPPLE COLESLAW
full_text:
3 cups shredded crisp cabbage
1 - 9 oz. can pineapple tidbits
1 cup diced apple
1 cup miniature marshmallows
1/2 cup celery
1/2 cup mayonnaise
Combine, tossing until mayonnaise coats all ingredients. Serves 4 - 6.
Mrs. Olive Zagres
Mrs. Evelyn Yahn
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: MENS FAVORITE SALAD
full_text:
1 - 3 1/2 oz. can fried onions
1/2 medium head of lettuce
5 cups fresh spinach (stems removed)
1/3 cup Italian dressing
Heat onions in a moderate oven for a few minutes to crispen. Wash greens thoroughly. Break lettuce and spinach in bite size pieces. Scatter warm onions on top. Add dressing. Toss lightly.
Mrs. Lloyd Clark
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CABBAGE SALAD
full_text:
1 large head cabbage (cut fine)
1 red mango diced (for color)
1 carrot chopped fine
1 green mango diced
Sprinkle with salt and set aside.
Dressing:
1 cup vinegar
1 cup sugar
1 cup water
Boil until sugar has dissolved. Pour over cabbage when it has cooled a bit. This dressing will keep up to a month without getting strong.
Minda Etheridge
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CUCUMBER SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. lime or lemon jello
1 cup boiling water
1/4 tsp. salt
1/2 cup salad dressing
2 tsp. minced green onion
1 cup dairy sour cream
1 cup minced pared cucumber
2 tbls. vinegar or lemon juice
Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add vinegar, salt and onion. Chill until it starts to set. Add sour cream and salad dressing, mix well. Fold in cucumbers. Pour into individual molds. Serve on lettuce. Serves 6.
Mrs. Eula Voehl
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: THREE P SALAD
full_text:
1 can peas
1/2 cup chopped salted peanuts
1/2 cup chopped sweet pickles
1/2 cup mayonnaise
Add a little sweet pickle vinegar to dressing for flavor.
Mrs. Orra Mullenix
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: BEAN SALAD
full_text:
1 can kidney beans
1 can cut green beans
1 can wax beans
Strain all juice off above and mix with:
1 cup vinegar
1 cup salad oil
1 cup sugar
Place in refrigerator and let chill for 24 hours before serving.
Mrs. Sophie Kunzman
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: RED CABBAGE SALAD
full_text:
Shredded cabbage, salt, pepper and sugar to taste. Sprinkle with vinegar and let stand for 10 min. Red cabbage will change to a beautiful red. Add salad oil and serve.
Mr. Hans R. Nickel
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: POINSETTIA SALAD
full_text:
Tomatoes
Lettuce
Cottage cheese
Peppers
French dressing
Select firm ripe tomatoes; scald, peel and chill. Place tomatoes on lettuce, cut in 1/8 parts and open like flower petals. Season cottage cheese with salt and paprika and force thru ricer. Fill tomatoes with cheese and serve with french dressing to which has been added green pepper. Sprinkle top with chopped nuts.
Mrs. Albert Hemleben
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: COTTAGE CHEESE RELISH
full_text:
3/4 cup dairy sour cream
1 1/2 cups large curd cottage cheese (drained)
1/4 cup diced green pepper
1/4 cup sliced green onion
2 tbls. chopped pimento
1/4 tsp. salt
dash of pepper
Blend sour cream with cottage cheese. Stir in chilled vegetables, salt and pepper. Serve on lettuce. Team with tomato and green pepper slices and olives on relish tray. Serves 4.
Mrs. Lloyd Clark
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CITRUS PERFECTION SALAD
full_text:
1 - 3 oz. pkg. lemon jello
1 cup hot water
1 tbls. vinegar
1/4 tsp. salt
1 - 1 lb. can grapefruit sections
1/2 cup diced celery
1 cup finely shredded cabbage
2 tbls. sliced stuffed olives
Dissolve jello in hot water. Add vinegar and salt. Drain grapefruit reserving syrup. Add water to syrup to make 1 cup, add to gelatine. Chill until partly set. Stir in grapefruit and remaining ingredients. Turn into a 1 qt. mold. Chill. Serves 6.
Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: BEET SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. lemon jello
1 can diced beets
1/2 cup diced celery
Drain beets and use 1 cup beet juice with 1 cup hot water and add to jello. Add 1/2 cup beets and celery. Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise.
Mrs. George Ahrens
Mrs. John Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: QUIK SALAD
full_text:
1 can green beans (with brown pods)
1 can drained shoe string beets
Mix together with vinegar and oil dressing.
Mrs. John Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: LORETTO SALAD
full_text:
Diced beets, diced boiled potatoes and diced apples. Mix with salad dressing.
Mr. Hans R. Nickel
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: POTATO SALAD
full_text:
1 qt. potatoes, cooked and diced
4 eggs hard boiled and diced
1 or 2 med. onions, diced
1 cup celery
Dressing for above:
1 egg beaten
1/4 tsp. salt
1/2 cup vinegar
1 tbls. mustard
1/2 cup sugar
1 tbls. butter
1 tbls. flour
Mix egg, vinegar, sugar, salt and flour together. Cook until thick. Add mustard and butter and let cool. Thin with a little cream and stir into potatoes.
Mrs. Henry W. Thomas
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
full_text:
6 good size potatoes
2 tsp. salt
1 pound chopped bacon
6 eggs
1/2 cup vinegar
1/4 tsp. pepper
3/4 cup chopped green onions
1/2 tsp. dill seed
Cook potatoes; peel and dice. Add vinegar and seasonings. Fry bacon until crisp. Cook eggs just 4 min. Combine potatoes, bacon and 2 tbls. bacon fat, onion and soft cooked eggs. Mix well and sprinkle top with little pieces of bacon. Serves 8.
Mrs. Evelyn Yahn
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: SOUR CREAM POTATO SALAD
full_text:
7 med. potatoes cooked in jackets, peeled and sliced to make 6 cups
1/3 cup clear French or Italian dressing
1/3 cup sliced green onion and tops
3/4 cup sliced celery
4 hard cooked eggs
1 cup mayonnaise
1/2 cup dairy sour cream
1 1/2 tsp. horseradish mustard
1/3 cup diced pared cucumber
salt and celery seed to taste
While potatoes are warm, pour dressing over and then chill for 2 hours. Add celery and onions. Chop egg whites and add. Sieve yolks; reserve some for garnish. Combine remaining egg yolk with mayonnaise, sour cream and mustard. Fold into salad. Add salt and celery seed. Chill salad for 2 hours. Add diced cucumber, mix. To trim, sprinkle reserved yolks and sliced onion tops over top.
Mrs. Lloyd Clark
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
full_text:
Boil 6 or 8 med. potatoes in their jackets. Cool, remove skins and slice. Add chopped or cut up onions to taste. Cut bacon up fine and brown or just use bacon grease. Add vinegar, sugar and salt to taste and bring to boil. Use vinegar enough that you think would mix thoroughly with potatoes. Pour hot over potatoes. Mix well.
Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: POTATO SALAD
full_text:
7 medium potatoes, cooked in jackets
1/2 cup salad oil (or less)
2 tbls. vinegar
1 tsp. salt
pepper
4 hard cooked eggs, sliced
1/3 cup onions
1/4 to 1/2 cup cult. sour cream
1 cup mayonnaise
Cook potatoes, peel and cube. Mix together oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Pour over cubed potatoes and refrigerate for several hours. Mix cream, mayonnaise, onions and eggs with potato mixture and refrigerate until ready to use.
Mrs. Thelma Jacobsen
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: SWISS CHEESE APPLE SALAD
full_text:
1/4 lb. swiss cheese diced
4 med. red apples
2 - 3 tbls. lemon juice
1 cup diced celery
1/8 tsp. salt
1 cup dairy sour cream
Quarter and core apples, dice. Sprinkle with lemon juice to keep from darkening. Add cheese, celery, salt and sour cream. Blend well. Serve in lettuce cups if desired.
Mrs. Roger Elsen
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: QUICK SALAD
full_text:
1 - 20 oz. can pineapple bits (drained)
1 tbls. flour
1/2 cup sugar
1 egg
Cook flour, sugar, egg and pineapple juice until thickened. Turn off heat and add 2 tbls. cheese whiz. Let cool. Add 1 1/2 cup small marshmallows and pineapple.
Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
1 med. can pineapple tidbits, drained
2 cans mandarin oranges, drained
1 small pkg. miniature marshmallows
1 can peach pie filling
Mix all ingredients together and chill in refrigerator until ready to serve, then add 2 cut up bananas. Mix well.
Mrs. Ida Pfeffer
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: HAWAIIAN WALDORD SALAD
full_text:
2 red apples (unpeeled, diced)
1 1/3 cups pineapple chunks (drained)
1/4 cup celery
1/4 cup mayonnaise
1/4 cup broken nutmeats
Combine and mix well. Serve on lettuce.
Mrs. Henry Thomas
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: QUICK FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
1 can mandarin oranges (drained)
1 small can pineapple chunks(drained)
1 can fruit cocktail (drained)
1 cup miniature marshmallows
1/4 cup broken nut meats
Whipped cream or dessert topping
Place drained fruits and other ingredients in bowl. Fold in whipped cream. Other fruit mixture may be used. I use bananas and grapes for a change.
Mrs. John Martsching
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FRUIT SALAD WITH LEMON WILDERNESS
full_text:
1 can pineapple
1 can mandarin oranges
3 or 4 bananas
1 cup marshmallows
1 can Wilderness lemon (or a little less)
nuts (optional)
Add bananas and marshmallows shortly before serving on lettuce. May garnish with whipped cream. Serves 8.
Mrs. Albert Hemleben
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: PINEAPPLE SALAD
full_text:
Blend 1/3 cup sugar and 2 tbls flour. Mix in 2 egg yolks. Drain a can of chunk pineapple and add juice to mixture and cook until thick. Combine with pineapple, marshmallows and bananas.
Mrs. Mildred Harmon
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CANDLE LIGHT SALAD
full_text:
Lettuce bed, slice of pineapple, place half banana in center, top with teaspoon salad dressing and sliver of almond. Light almond, it will burn.
Mr. Hans R. Nickel
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: MARSHMALLOW - APPLE SALAD
full_text:
12 marshmallows
6 large mellow apples
3 bananas
1/4 cup chopped black walnuts
1/4 cup sugar
1/4 cup cream
1 tbls. salad dressing
Pare apple and bananas. Cube them and marshmallows into mixing bowl. Add sugar, cream, salad dressing and black walnuts. Stir thoroughly and put into bowl or dishes for serving. Serves 6 to 8.
Mrs. Sophie Kunzman
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: JUBILEE SALAD
full_text:
2 oranges peeled and sectioned
1 No. 303 can pitted white cherries
1 No. 2 can peach or apricot pie filling
2 cups miniature marshmallows
1/2 cup heavy cream whipped
1/4 cup salad dressing
Combine drained fruits, pie filling. Add marshmallows. Fold whipped cream into salad dressing. Mix. Serves 6 = 8.
Miss Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FIVE CUP SALAD
full_text:
1 cup cocoanut
1 cup crushed pineapple
1 cup mandarin oranges
1 cup sour cream
1 cup miniature marshmallows
Drain pineapple and mandarin oranges. Add cocoanut and sour cream. Mix well.
Mrs. Henry W. Thomas
Mrs. Ed Myers
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: BANANA WALDORF SALAD
full_text:
3 cups diced unpeeled apples
2 or 3 bananas sliced
1 tbls. lemon juice
1 cup marshmallows
1 cup chopped celery
1/4 cup chopped walnuts
Sprinkle apples and bananas with lemon juice. Add marshmallows, celery and nuts with enough mayonnaise to moisten, toss lightly.
Mrs. Roger Elsen
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: TWENTY FOUR HOUR SALAD
full_text:
3 beaten egg yolks
2 tbls. sugar
2 tbls. vinegar
2 tbls. pineapple syrup
1 tble. butter
dash salt
2 cups drained pitted white cherries
2 cups drained pineapple tidbits
2 pared oranges cut up and drained
2 cups mini. marshmallows
1 cup heavy cream whipped
Combine egg yolks, sugar, vinegar, pineapple syrup, butter and salt in top of double boiler. Cook until thick stirring constantly. Cool. Stir in cherries, pineapples tidbits and marshmallows. Fold in whipped cream. Chill 24 hours. Place orange slices, maraschino cherries, green seedless grapes over a salad. Tuck in sprig of mint. Serve as salad or dessert.
Serves 6 to 8
Mrs. Olive Zagres
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: LADIES DELIGHT FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
1 No. 2 can pineapple tidbits
1 No. 2 can seedless grapes or fresh
1 can mandarin oranges
4 apples peeled and diced
1 pkg. (8 oz.) mini. marshmallows
Mix with salad dressing.
Mr. Hans R. Nickel
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: SPICY PEACH SALAD
full_text:
1 cup canned sliced cling peaches
1 pkg. peach gelatin
1/4 cup sugar
1/4 tsp. cinnamon
1/8 tsp. cloves
1 cup boiling water
3/4 cup peach syrup
2 tbls. vinegar
Drain peaches, reserving syrup. Dissolve gelatin, sugar and spices in boiling water. Stir in peach syrup and vinegar. Chill until thick. Add peaches. Pour into 3 cup mold, chill until firm.
Mrs. Sophie Kunzman
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
1 No. 2 can pineapple bits (drained)
1 No. 2 can white cherries (drained and pitted)
1 No. 2 1/2 can apricots (drained and cut up)
Melt in double boiler:
1 tbls. butter
Add 1 tbls flour
pineapple juice
1 tbls sugar
1 tbls. lemon juice
1 egg
Cook and stir until smooth. Cool and fold in 1 cup whipped cream. Fold in fruit and freeze.
Miss Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
1 large can salad fruit (drained)
1 - 3 oz pkg. cream cheese
1/4 cup maraschino cherries
5 tbls. salad dressing
1 banana sliced
1 cup heavy cream whipped
Add softened cream cheese to whipped cream, salad dressing and add fruit. Freeze in refrig. tray. Serve on lettuce.
Mrs. Erna Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FROSTY CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 16 oz. whole cranberry sauce
1 8 3/4 oz. can crushed pineapple (drained)
1 cup dairy sour cream
1/4 cup sifted confectioner sugar
Combine cranberry sauce and crushed pineapple. Stir together sour cream and powdered sugar, add to fruit mixture. Line a 3 cup refrig. tray with alum. foil. Pour in fruit mixture. Freeze firm. To serve, turn out frozen salad and let stand a few minutes at room temp. Remove foil and cut in 6 wedges. If desired, cut 3 well drained pineapple rings in half and place one atop each serving.
Mrs. Eula Voehl
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
2 3 oz. pkg. cream cheese
1/2 cup mayonnaise
pinch salt
1/2 cup cream whipped
1/2 cup orange pieces
1 cup quartered strawberries
1/2 cup cubed pineapple
1/3 cup toasted almonds
Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and salt. Add fruit and nuts. Fold in whipped cream. Package in airtight container. Freeze at once. Slice and serve frozen on lettuce.
Mrs. Jack Heinje
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
full_text:
1 cup whipped cream
2 tbls. powdered sugar
1/2 cup mayonnaise
2 cups fruit cocktail (drained)
1/2 tsp. salt
Whip cream, fold in mayonnaise and cocktail. Put in tray and freeze. Serve on lettuce.
Miss Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CHERRY CREAM FREEZE
full_text:
1 1/3 cup (15 oz.) sweetened cond. milk
1/4 cup lemon juice
2 1/2 cups (1 lb. 5 oz.) cherry pie filling
3/4 cup (9 oz.) crushed pineapple drained
1/4 tsp. almond extract
2 cups heavy cream whipped
In large mixing bowl, combine milk, lemon juice, pie filling, pineapple and extract, mix well. Gently fold in whipped cream until evenly blended. Turn mixture into a 9 x 5 x 3 pan. Cover lightly with foil, freeze 24 hours. Unmold onto serving tray. Makes 2 quarts.
Mrs. Roger Elsen
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CHICKEN SALAD
full_text:
3 cups cubed, cooked chicken
1 1/2 cups diced celery
1 tsp salt
3 hard cooked eggs, chopped
3 sweet pickles, chopped
mayonnaise
Combine five ingredients and moisten with mayonnaise. Serve on salad greens and garnish with additional egg slices and olives.
Serves 6 - 8.
Mrs. Thelma Jacobsen
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CHICKEN SALAD
full_text:
2 cups diced cooked chicken
1 cup chopped celery
1/2 cup chopped stuffed olives
3 hard boiled eggs
mayonnaise
lettuce
Combine chicken celery and olives with enough mayonnaise to moisten. Slice 2 eggs in quarters. Force remaining egg through sieve. Arrange mixture on lettuce. Sprinkle with sieved egg.
Mrs. John Martsching
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: OVEN CHICKEN SALAD
full_text:
2 cups cooked cubed chicken
2 cups thinly sliced celery
1 cup toasted bread cubes
1 cup mayonnaise
2 tbls. lemon juice
2 tbls. grated onion
1/2 tsp. salt
1/2 cup grated cheese
1 cup toasted bread cubes or potato chips
Heat oven to 450 (hot). Combine all ingredients except cheese and 1 cup bread cubes, mix. Pile lightly into individual baking dishes or one large one. About 9 x 9 x 2 or deep bowl. Sprinkle with topping and grated cheese. Bake 10 - 15 min. or until bubbly. Serves 6.
Mrs. Evonne Myers
Mrs. Carolyn Sauerbrei
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CHICKEN SALAD
full_text:
1 cup chow mein noodles
1 cup shredded carrots
1/4 cup minced onion
1 cup diced celery
1/2 cup mayonnaise
small amount of cream
1 cup diced chicken (tuna or salmon)
Mix all but the chow mein noodles and chill in the refrigerator. Just before serving, toss in the noodles and serve. Leave the noodles until last so they stay crunchy. Mrs. W. E. Cudworth
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CORNED BEEF SALAD
full_text:
1 can corned beef cubed
2 cups chopped celery
2 tbls. chopped onion
2 tbls. chopped green pepper
3 hard boiled eggs, chopped
2 pkg. lemon jello
3 1/2 cups boiling water
2 tbls. lemon juice
1 cup salad dressing
Dissolve jello in hot water. When partly set add other ingredients. Pour into lightly oiled mold. Serves 10 - 12.
Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FISH MOLD
full_text:
1 can tomato soup
3 - 3 oz. pkgs cream cheese
1 tbls. unflavored gelatin
1/2 cup cold water
1 cup mayonnaise
1 small can lobster or crab (mashed)
1/2 cup chopped olives or green peppers
1/2 cup celery
1/2 tsp. salt
onion flavoring
Heat tomato soup, melt cheese in soup, then add gelatin that has been soaked in cold water. Cool. Add mayonnaise and salt and cool until it jells, then add rest of ingredients. Oil mold. If using fish mold, use olives for fish eyes.
Mrs. Erna Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: MOLDED EGG SALAD
full_text:
1 tbls. unflavored gelatin
3/4 cup water
2 tbls. lemon juice
1 tsp. salt
1/4 tsp. worchester sauce
dash cayenne pepper
1/2 cup mayonnaise
1/2 cup finely diced celery
1/4 cup diced green pepper
1/4 cup chopped pimento
2 tsp. grated onion
4 hard cooked eggs, chopped
Dissolve gelatin in water over low heat, stir constantly. Remove from heat; add lemon juice, salt, w. sauce and pepper. Chill until syrupy. Blend in remaining ingredients and chill until firm in 9 x 5 x 3 pan or mold. Serve on lettuce, garnish with sliced eggs, radishes, cucumber or pepper rings.
Mrs. V. L. O'Mara
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: DELICATESSEN SALAD
full_text:
1 cup diced beef or chicken
1 cup diced ham
1 cup diced boiled potatoes
1 cup peeled dill pickles, diced
1 cup peeled apples diced
1 cup diced beets
1/2 cup diced herring
mayonnaise
1 tbls. worcester sauce
1/2 tbls. sugar
1 tbls. mustard
pepper to taste
Let marinate over night in refrigerator. Serve in bowl on lettuce leaf. Decorate with hard boiled eggs and capers. Serves 10 - 12. Good for luncheons and picnics.
Mr. Hans Nickel
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: SHRIMP WILD RICE SALAD
full_text:
2 cans shrimp
1 can crab meat
8 oz. pkg. wild or brown rice
Mix together, add mayonnaise to taste and let stand overnight. Add can of water chestnuts, diced, two hours before serving.
Mrs. Mel Roewert
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FRESH SHRIMP SALAD
full_text:
5 Jumbo shrimp cut up into 4 pieces
1 diced celery branch
1 diced hard boiled egg
6 sliced stuffed olives
1 tbls. salad dressing
1 dash lemon juice and worchester sauce
Serve in lettuce cup on shredded lettuce. Garnish with tomato wedges and hard boiled eggs.
Mr. Hans Nickel
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: PINK CLOUD SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. red jello
1 cup cream whipped
1 cup cranberry sauce.
Set 1 pkg. red jello until it begins to thicken. Whip until it holds peaks. Whip 1 cup cream and whip it into jello. Add 1 cup cranberry sauce and whip. Set overnight for best results.
Mrs. Harry W. Thomas
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 lb. cranberries ground
1 lb. miniature marshmallows
1 No. 2 can crushed pineapple
1 cup sugar
1 cup whipped cream
Blend all ingredients. Chill and serve.
Mrs. Ed Myers
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 Pkg. cranberries
2 cups sugar
1 cup pineapple crushed and drained
1 10 1/2 oz. pkg. miniature marshmallows
1 1/2 cups halved seeded tokay grapes
1/2 cup chopped walnuts
1 pt. whipping cream whipped
Grind raw cranberries and add sugar. Stir and leave in refrig. until cool and sugar is dissolved. Add marshmallows, pineapple and grapes. Last of all add nuts and fold in cream (whipped). This may be made ahead and frozen. Remove from freezer 2 - 3 hours before serving.
Mrs. Jack Heinje
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: MOLDED CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 lb. cranberries
2 cups sugar
2 cups water
2 tbls. Knox gelatin
1/2 cup cold water
1 cup finely chopped celery
1/2 cup chopped walnuts
1/2 tsp. salt
Combine cranberries, sugar and water in sauce pan. Bring to a boil over med. heat. Lower heat and cook 5 min. Strain. Soften gelatine in cold water. Add to cranberry mixture together with salt. Cool until syrupy. Add celery and nuts. Pour into 1 large mold or into 8 individual molds. Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce.
Mrs. Laura Voehl
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
2 pkg. raspberry jello
2 cups hot water
Mix and let cool.
1 lb. cranberries
3 small oranges
3 small apples
Grind cranberries, oranges and apples
1/2 cup nut meats
sugar, same amount as you have ground cranberries.
Stir into chilled jello.
Mrs. Sophie Kunzman
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 qt. cranberries
1 cup water
2 cups sugar
15 marshmallows
1 pkg. rasp. or lemon jello
1 cup celery diced
1 cup raw apples diced
1 cup pecans chopped
Boil cranberries, water and sugar together until berries are soft. While mixture is hot, whip in marshmallows and gelatin. Let cool, then add celery, apples and nuts. Chill 24 hours before serving. Will keep several days.
Mrs. Harry W. Thomas
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY CREAM SALAD
full_text:
1 lb. can whole cranberry sauce
2 tsp. orange rind
2 large oranges
1 tbls. lemon juice
1 - 3 oz. pkg. orange jello
1 pt. vanilla ice cream
Break apart cranberry sauce and drain, reserving the liquid. Peel oranges and dice sections, reserving the juice. Combine cranberry liquid, orange and lemon juices and enough water to make 1 cup. Heat to boiling and pour over gelatin, stirring until dissolved. Add ice cream mixing until well blended. Chill until jelly-like in consistency (this will take only a short time). Fold in orange rind, diced oranges and cranberry sauce. Pour into 8 x 8 x 2 pan and chill until firm. Serves 8.
Mrs. Roger Elsen
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: MOLDED CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 - 3 oz pkg. strawberry jello
1 - 3. oz pkg. lime jello
4 drops green food coloring
1 - 14 oz jar orange cranberry relish
1 - 3 oz pkg. cream cheese
1/2 cup miracle whip
1/2 cup cream, whipped
2 cups miniature marshmallows
Early in day:
In medium bowl, dissolve strawberry jello with 1 cup hot water. Add cranberry relish. Pour into oiled 1 1/2 qt. mold. Chill until firm. Meanwhile in medium bowl prepare lime jello as label directs. Add food coloring. Chill until mixture is partially set. In small bowl, beat cream cheese with fork until fluffy. Add miracle whip and mix together well. Fold mixture into lime jello. Stir in whipped cream and marshmallows. Pour mixture over strawberry-cranberry layer. Chill until firm. Just before serving, turn mold out on platter and garnish with parsley.
Serves 8.
Mrs. Clara Bohlman
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: FROSTY CRANBERRY MOLD
full_text:
1 (8 1/2 oz) can crushed pineapple
1 (1 lb) can whole cranberry sauce
2 - 3 oz pkg raspberry jello
1 - 8 oz pkg. cream cheese
2 tbls. salad dressing
1 cup heavy cream whipped or 1 pkg topping mix
1/2 cup walnuts coarsely chopped
1 tart apple, peeled and chopped
Drain fruit, reserving liquid. Add water to make 2 cups. Bring to boil. Dissolve jello in hot liquid. Chill until partially set. Beat softened cream cheese and dressing together until fluffy. Gradually beat in jello. Fold this mixture into whipped cream. Set aside 1 1/2 cups of this mixture. Add drained fruit, nuts and apple to remaining cheese-jello mixture. Pour into 12 x 7 1/2 x 2 pan and refrigerate until surface sets, (about 20 min.) Frost with reserved topping. Refrigerate several hours. This may be frozen. Remove from freezer to refrigerator 1 hour before serving. Serves 12.
Mrs. Jack Heinje
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 lb. cranberries
1 No. 2 can crushed pineapple
1 pkg. orange jello
3/4 cup celery, cut fine
1 cup nut meats, chopped
Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water. Cool. Grind cranberries and drain. Do not use juice. Boil cranberries for 1 minute with 2 cups sugar. Stir to prevent scorching. Cool. Drain pineapple. Add pulp only, to other ingredients. Combine all with jello. Refrigerate.
Lorene Hein
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY ORANGE SALAD
full_text:
1 can whole cranberries
1 pkg. cherry jello
1 cup finely cut celery
1 cup hot water
1/2 cup cold water
1 large orange or 1 small can mandarin oranges cut up
1 cup finely cut apples
Set jello with water and when slightly jelled, add rest of ingredients. Mold. Serves 8.
Mrs. Erna Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: EASY CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 - 3 oz pkg cherry jello
1 cup hot water
2 tsp. lemon juice
1 - 3 oz pkg. cream cheese, soft
1/8 tsp. salt
1/4 cup salad dressing
1 lb. can whole cranberry sauce
1/2 cup minced celery
1/4 cup toasted slivered almonds
1/2 cup drained crushed pineapple
Dissolve jello in hot water. Add lemon juice, cheese, salt, dressing and blend well with electric mixer. Chill until mixture begins to thicken. Whip until fluffy and stir in sauce, celery, almonds and pineapple.
Mrs. V. L. O'Mara
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
Prepare 3 oz. pkg. lemon jello as directed. Grind 1 lb. cranberries. Add 1/2 cup sugar, cut up (celery and apples) or (pineapple and grapes) and nuts. Stir all into jello as it thickens. Use large bowl.
Mrs. Orra Mullenix
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. cherry jello
1 cup sugar
1 cup hot water
1/4 cup chopped nuts
1 cup ground cranberries
1/2 cup chopped celery
1/2 cup chopped apples
Dissolve jello in water and cool until slightly set. Mix the cranberries with sugar and let set 30 minutes, then add to jello with rest of ingredients and mold.
Mrs. Erna Logan
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: CRANBERRY SALAD
full_text:
1 pkg. raspberry jello
1 cup hot water
1 can jellied cranberry sauce
1 unpeeled, cored apple
1/4 or 1/2 lemon with rind
Dissolve jello in hot water, add cranberry sauce, and blend. Put apple and lemon thru food chopper and add to gelatin. Chill.
Mrs. Mildred Harmon
organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

title: 24 HOUR SALAD
full_text:
1 pound marshmallows
Cook 3 egg yolks
1 can grated pineapple
1/4 cup cream
1 pound white grapes
Juice 2 lemons
